candidate_scope: reference, E and F; only E full-image timing at 8 threads
measures: Haar HH MAD (Y and Co/Cg) and mid-band (Gaussian 1 - 4) MAD ratios output/input on the inner zone; mid-band Y correlation; mean drifts; correlation of the removed |dY| with the smoothed input gradient (high = structure removed). No clean reference: no MAE/PSNR.

noise_profile_calibration.scope: R6 Mark III pairs; transfer to R7 and 60D remains experimental
